project_name: Website hero background - dark premium workspace
format: Silent 8 second website hero background loop. The music is the entire audio layer at full level; there is no speech.

scene.description: A near-black contemporary interior with a minimal dark desk. Warm copper-gold light passes through a clear glass prism, sending slow refracted bands and soft caustic streaks across the dark surface, grazing the edge of a closed laptop. The left of frame stays deep and quiet; motion is restrained to the slow drift of warm light.
scene.mood: calm, premium, modern, controlled, warm, quietly confident

music_direction.intent: A present, intentional foreground bed that mirrors light slowly emerging from darkness: warm, spacious and unhurried, with a sense of clarity and order arriving. It carries the clip on its own without competing for attention.
music_direction.instrumentation: warm low synth foundation, soft felt-piano motif, slow-breathing analog pad, sparse soft electronic pulse, faint glassy shimmer accents
music_direction.energy: low and steady with a gentle gradual bloom across the clip, no drops, no builds to a climax, no rhythmic urgency
music_direction.fade: gentle fade in over the first second, clean unhurried fade out at the end
avoid: any reference to a specific artist or song

notes: Visuals are near-black with warm amber and copper refraction only; the music should feel like the audio equivalent of that palette: warm, dark, precise, premium. Silent job: this bed is the sole audio layer.
